mathematical_contract.product_enclosure: For fixed-sign intervals, monotonicity determines the exact lower and upper corner products, so only two endpoint products are needed. If both intervals straddle zero, all four corner products are still evaluated. The resulting closed interval is identical to the four-corner reference enclosure.
mathematical_contract.subtraction: Closed interval subtraction remains [a,b]-[c,d]=[a-d,b-c]; mutating accumulation changes ownership only.
mathematical_contract.scalar_product: A nonnegative scalar preserves endpoint order, a negative scalar reverses it, and zero returns the exact point interval [0,0].
mathematical_contract.certification: The locally certified lift still requires one determinant Bernstein sign variation, nonzero endpoints, a nonzero global leading coefficient, and containment in the selected rational image interval before publishing an algebraic parameter.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 share the same exact interval, determinant, candidate, and topology graph. APPROXIMATE_512 remains only the terminal unresolved equality/sign policy and introduces no approximate interval endpoint or geometry.
